item.title: PGlite – Embeddable Postgres
item.description:
📝 Run a full Postgres database locally in WASM with reactivity and live sync. Dynamic extension loading mechanism, including support for pgvector. Create and publish a Postgres database using AI built on PGlite by Supabase: This is a full PGlite Postgres running in your browser.
🔗 Read more: https://pglite.dev/

item.title: It’s time to free JavaScript
item.description:
